output: Hypothesis: There is a statistically significant relationship between gender and degree completion rates in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79) dataset. Specifically, females (Sex of respondent, 1979 = 2) have a higher mean highest grade completed (10.61) compared to males (Sex of respondent, 1979 = 1) with a mean of 10.38. This difference is statistically significant, as indicated by a t-statistic of -5.69 and a p-value of approximately 1.29e-08, which is well below the conventional threshold of 0.05 for statistical significance.
